item.title: SQUAD NEWS | Tom O’Connor returns from loan spell after injury
item.description: Wrexham AFC can confirm Tom O’Connor’s loan spell with Peterborough United has been terminated with the versatile Irishman needing injury treatment. Back-to-back-to-back promotion winner O’Connor, 26, moved on loan to Peterborough on Deadline Day with fellow Red Dragon Jacob Mendy. Playing most often at centre-back, he has appeared 19 times for The Posh this season. item.title: TRANSFER NEWS | Jacob Mendy signs permanent Peterborough United deal
item.description: Wrexham AFC can confirm Gambian international wing-back Jacob Mendy has signed a permanent deal with Peterborough United. Mendy, 29, signed for Wrexham in 2022, going on to become one of ten players to achieve back-to-back-to-back promotions with the Red Dragons. He signed on loan for Peterborough United on Deadline Day, making six appearances before an injury lay-off. item.title: SIGNED | Davis Keillor-Dunn returns to Wrexham
item.description: Wrexham AFC are delighted to confirm the signing of Davis Keillor-Dunn from League One side Barnsley for an undisclosed fee. The 28-year-old striker has signed a contract until the end of the 2028/29 season. A former Red Dragon, Keillor-Dunn returns to the Club where he made three starts and three substitute appearances, and scored one memorable goal against Bromley in the 2019/20 season. item.description: A name that may be familiar to supporters, Davis Keillor-Dunn returns to the Club for the first time since 2020, when he initially joined the Red Dragons on a short-term deal. item.title: LOANED OUT | Harry Ashfield joins Cheltenham Town on loan
item.description: Wrexham AFC can confirm midfielder Harry Ashfield has completed a loan move to Cheltenham Town until the end of the 2025/26 campaign. A lifelong Wrexham fan, Ashfield has been with the club since 2015, making his first-team debut in our 3-0 EFL Trophy victory over Crewe Alexandra in 2023. Steve Cotterill’s Cheltenham side currently sit 18th in League Two with 30 points from 28 games. item.title: LOANED OUT | Ryan Hardie joins Huddersfield Town on loan
item.description: Wrexham AFC can confirm Ryan Hardie has completed a loan move to Huddersfield Town until the end of the 2025/26 campaign. The 28-year-old Scottish striker has made 10 appearances in all competitions for Wrexham this season, netting one goal in the EFL Cup against Preston North End. The Terriers currently sit in the play-off places in League One, following three straight victories against Bradford, Luton and Peterborough. item.title: LOANED OUT | Mo Faal joins Cheltenham Town on loan
item.description: Wrexham AFC can confirm striker Mo Faal has completed a loan move to Cheltenham Town for the remainder of the 2025/26 campaign. Faal arrived in North Wales in summer 2024, as a graduate of West Bromwich Albion’s academy, scoring three goals in his debut season. He started the current campaign on loan at Port Vale but returned last month after injury, and will now complete the season with Steve Cotterill’s Cheltenham Town.
